name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-video-wuyinkeji
description: Wuyinkeji (api.wuyinkeji.com) async video-generation provider for the DeepSeek Harness video seam (ctx.video) — submits text prompts to the public Google-Omni video task endpoint with optional size, duration, reference-image, and reference-video hints, polls its result-detail endpoint until the task settles, downloads the URL-scoped answer into raw bytes, reads the API key from a named environment variable at call time, and surfaces endpoint failures as typed VIDEO_PROVIDER_FAILED errors with no local fallback
